scenes.title: runtime-texture-size
lines: First identify the object on screen. The asset exposes virtual dimensions and tile settings. Distinguish the addressable extent from the resident contents. A large address range does not mean every texel is simultaneously resident. Addressing data also needs storage, so budget addresses and contents separately.

scenes.title: geometry-car-material
lines: First identify the object on screen. The car’s surface appearance changes. Keep the body and wheel as references while separating shape from material appearance.
